provenance.policy: Expected status/stdout/stderr are copied exclusively from each original record.native.profiles[1], authenticated Bash 5.3.0. No baseline or virtual output is used. The original 5.2 tests, captures, import-only extracted programs and replay driver are retained in the archive. Unit fixtures retain program bodies and exact output assertions; only the four argv0 test titles are corrected for the primary version.
